wikipedia: Taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve

predecessors.name: Taifa of Badajoz
predecessors.text: the eastern Algarve around Santa Maria: 'located in what is now southern Portugal'

ledger.x: 1018: the Harunid taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve appears.
1051: Seville conquers Santa Maria do Algarve.
1051: the taifa ends under Muhammad al-Mu'tasim and its land passes to Seville; 'their descendants remained as Qadis of the city until its reconquest by Portugal in 1249'.

wars.name: Abbadid conquest of Santa Maria do Algarve
wars.outcome: Seville conquered the taifa in 1051 and held it to 1091.

certainty.note: The page names the capital and 'southern Portugal' only; the coast is firm, the inland frontier with Badajoz approximate.
